system-characteristics.description: Thales Knowledge Extraction to Information Retrieval — document analysis, Vespa RAG, ingest, audit, and governor stack.

information-types.title: Document analysis and RAG operational data
information-types.description: Ingested documents, embeddings, ActionRecords (request_hash by default), audit WORM segments.

authorization-boundary.description: The T-KEIR authorization boundary is the repository, host services (pipeline, Vespa, HMI, ingest, RAG, audit, governor, Keycloak), and generated evidence under reports/. Customer data in Vespa user streaming groups is in-boundary for the operating tenant.

users.title: Analyst / operator
users.description: Authenticated HMI and API users who submit search, RAG, and ingest requests.

components.title: T-KEIR platform
components.description: Umbrella system covering pipeline, Vespa RAG, HMI, ingest, audit, governor, and Keycloak.

control-implementation.description: Control implementations are documented in ../component-definitions/tkeir_components.json and assessed via OPA policies under compliance/opa/policies/.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Logging and traceability via ActionRecord v1 and WORM archive. Per-component implemented-requirements live in the T-KEIR component definition.
